verdict.rationale: Elicit documents a pre-run effort slider (Fastest through Smartest) for Research Agent sessions, which covers depth and effort. Scope can be steered through query filters, and the API's Systematic Review endpoint exposes control over search strategy and screening criteria. All of this control is set before the run; nothing shows the user adjusting depth, effort or scope while a run executes, and post-run iteration is not mid-run steering. missing for 10: steering while the run executes (mid-run adjustment of effort/depth/scope), explicit depth controls separate from the effort level, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a researcher, I can steer the depth, effort, and scope of a research run before or while it executes

citations.quote: Every Research Agent session runs at an effort level, which you set from the slider in the prompt box before you send your question.
click it to open the slider and move between Fastest, Fast, Balanced, Smart, and Smartest
The simplest way to filter is to just say what you want in your Research Agent query. Elicit will automatically detect and apply the right filter.
Systematic Review: run a full review end to end, with control over search strategy, screening criteria, extraction parameters, and reporting.
